SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya -Wildlife -Historical Sites -Natural Sceneries, part of Resources and Economic Activities in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is wildlife important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya -Wildlife -Historical Sites -Natural Sceneries together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn: Learners share what they have learnt as they write an essay on the contribution of tourism to the economy of Kenya.

● Communication and Collaboration: Learners speak clearly and effectively as they brainstorm on main tourist attractions in Kenya.

Values:
● Unity: Learners display team spirit as they debate on the contribution of tourism to the economy of Kenya.

● Responsibility: Learners engage in tasks as they write an essay on the contribution of tourism to the economy of Kenya.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social Cohesion: Learners work together as they write essays on the contribution of tourism to the economy of Kenya.

Link to other subjects

Learners develop writing skills as they write an essay on the contribution of tourism to the economy of Kenya.
